title: Enchants of TNT
description: I little datapack that adds some Enchants, currently only 3, reverence is for a bow/crossbow, Epitaph is for a Netherite Sword, and reqium is for offhand nether star.
body:
_The DataPack is made for my friends realm, specifically for Season 2 of the lifesteal Section. I never intentionaly wanted to realease it to the public, but why not?_

# DataPack Overview:

<details>
<summary>Reverence Enchantment</summary>
The Reverence Enchantment is for the bow/crossbow, it adds a extra arrow to be fired alongside the original arrow, on a crossbow, it also adds 1 second longer to charge, although it also works with the multishot enchantment. On a bow, it just fires a extra arrow, but also uses one more arrow. The enchant has conflict with Power, Quick Charge, and Piercing.
</details>

<details>
<summary>Reqium Enchantment</summary>
The Reqium Enchantment works with a nether star in your offhand, while expencive, it has a permanent thorns effect, dealing random between 1 to 3 damage to the attacker. It also add 1 extra armor. No debuffs except it is expensive and takes up your offhand
</details>

<details>
<summary>Epitaph Enchantment</summary>
The Epitaph Enchantment does various things, for example it gives the mending effect, it also has a chance to heal you, and it plays a particle when you hit someone (WIP) It has conflict with sharpness, Mending, and it only goes on a netherite sword.
</details>
